vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Quiet birds. I'll add it to the list of things that mean something."
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Daniyar about A man, maybe 50s, with a long braid. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇮🇳 Hindi. You share no language at all.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Michelle, Daniyar and Ursula met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Michelle, Daniyar, Ursula are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniel just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniel just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Leo, Daniel, Daniyar, Ursula and Maya met them at the door — 5 put down. Leo, Daniel, Daniyar, Ursula are hurt.

regDeaths.name: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
